why: Owner ruling, Abilash in chat, 2026-09-19: 'make all these pages 301'. These twelve routes were surfaced by the template-family audit (docs/reports/2026-09-19-ahv-article-template-families-and-design-brief.md §7) as pages that needed a fate rather than a design: six WordPress leftovers with no subject, three '-old' duplicates of pages that now exist properly, two WooCommerce routes on a site that has no commerce, and one 93% copy of a page that earns 236 clicks while it earns 0. Every source measures ZERO clicks in the Search Console export (launches/ayurvedichealingvillage.com/baseline/raw/gsc-ui-export-2026-07-19{,-www}/Pages.csv), so no ranking value is being moved; every target is an existing, content-rich approved route, which is the CLAUDE.md BUILD DECISION MATRIX rule 2 condition ('content-rich ranking pages are never redirected to thin targets'). Single hop only: no target here is itself a source. Supersedes the earlier 'Keep outside navigation' ownerAction recorded against /cart/ and /checkout/ in confirmation-family-data.js, and the sitemapExclude-only treatment in route-overrides.json, both of which left the pages serving.
scope: Applies at the DNS flip, like every other route rule in this lane. Nothing changes on the production WordPress host from here (HARD GATE 1); these redirects take effect when this build becomes the live site.
statusNote: 301 explicitly, not Next's permanent:true (which emits 308). The owner asked for 301 and there is no reason to substitute a different code.

/test-page/.reason: h1 'Test Page'. A WordPress scratch page with no subject and nothing to consolidate.

/test-page-2/.reason: h1 'Test Page' but the head title is 'Write a Review | Give Testimonials | Opinions | Feedback' - it is a scratch copy of the feedback page, so the signal belongs there.

/testing/.reason: h1 'Testing'. A WordPress scratch page with no subject.

/gift-test/.reason: h1 'Shop' - a WooCommerce shop-page test. There is no shop; gift vouchers are the nearest real page on the same subject.

/my-account/.reason: WooCommerce account page. No commerce, no accounts, nothing equivalent to send it to.

/how-to-reach-old/.reason: Superseded duplicate. The current page carries all four maps and earns 410 clicks.

/contact-us-old/.reason: Superseded duplicate. The current page earns 310 clicks.

/enquiry-form-old/.reason: Superseded duplicate of the enquiry form.

/online-consultation-old/.reason: Superseded duplicate. The current page earns 379 clicks, the most of any page in scope.

/cart/.reason: WooCommerce cart on a site with no commerce. A visitor who reached a cart was choosing something to book; /packages/ is the content-rich equivalent (733 words, 27 cards, 118 clicks).

/checkout/.reason: WooCommerce checkout on a site with no commerce. Same target and same reason as /cart/.

/offers/new/.reason: 93% identical to the senior-citizen offer, which earns 236 clicks while this earns 0. Its canonical already pointed here (route-overrides.json); the 301 makes the consolidation real instead of advisory.
